intro.title: Complete your booking payment
intro.description: Choose a payment method, verify the authorised payer and review the amount before confirming. Your booking is protected against duplicate charges.
intro.asideDescription: Payment information is encrypted and never displayed in full.

help.title: Need help with a transaction?
help.description: Contact us with your booking and payment reference. Never send full card details by email.

outcome.successSubtitle: Thank you for your order. Your receipt has been sent to your email.
